==Coaches with multiple Super Bowl appearances==
{| class="wikitable"
|bgcolor="#FFE6BD"|<small>'''[[List of Pro Football Hall of Fame inductees|Elected to Hall of Fame as Coach]]'''</small>
|bgcolor="#00ff7f"|<small>'''Active Coach'''</small>
|}

The following NFL head coaches have coached in two or more Super Bowls. Of eligible coaches not in the [[Pro Football Hall of Fame|Hall of Fame]], only three have had three or more appearances: [[Bill Belichick]], [[Mike Holmgren]] and [[Dan Reeves]]. There are four eligible coaches with multiple wins to not be inducted into the Hall of Fame: [[Bill Belichick]], [[Tom Coughlin]], [[George Seifert]] and [[Mike Shanahan]]. 

<small> Sort chart by clicking arrows by heading.<br>
In descending order, the tiebreakers are – 1) Better win percentage 2) Earliest Super Bowl</small>
